title: GLM-5.3-Flash · 1× RTX 3090 · 58 GB RAM + NVMe RAID0 · S3b env, prefetch off
change: S3b env + GLM53_NV_PREFETCH=0 (glm53u instrumented code) at --memory 58g --memory-swap 58g: the RAM tier sizes itself to 5172 slots (45.5 GiB, +341 experts vs 55 GB); RAID0 /mnt/nvx store unchanged

quality.decode_kl_method: same process, CPU lane off (exact GPU path) greedy natural-EOS reference vs forced decode of the same tokens with the CPU lane on

method.active_windows: per sample interval from the engine's live counters: decode = dec_reqs advanced, prefill = staged layers / prefill tokens advanced, mixed = both (excluded), idle = neither
method.gpu_util_pct: NVML utilization.gpu: % of time a kernel was resident (spin-waiting kernels count as busy)
method.vram_busy_pct: NVML utilization.memory: % of time the memory controller was busy (time-based, not GB/s; an upper bound on VRAM bandwidth use vs the 936 GB/s ceiling)
method.pcie: NVML PCIe throughput rx/tx (device view, 20 ms window per sample)
method.nvme_read_gbps: /proc/diskstats sectors read on the md array
method.cpu: /proc/stat busy per core over the server cpuset (spin counts as busy); cpu_lane_duty_pct = engine CPU job time / wall (useful work)
method.ddr_derived_gbps: derived (no DF/UMC counters without root): CPU-lane weight bytes + PCIe rx + PCIe tx + NVMe read bytes
